name: Jezero Crater
summary: Perseverance's landing site and traverse on the USGS Mars 2020 CTX elevation model.

frame.note: x = R cos(lat_c) dlon, y = R dlat on the 3,396,190 m sphere; east-west scale error within +/-0.3 % across the region

grid.note: 20 m DTM averaged to 60 m for the 3D mesh and readouts; layers keep 20 m detail

slope.note: 20 m slope averaged over 60 m cells

layers.name: Relief
layers.note: CTX DTM 20 m, hillshade (2x) over elevation colour

layers.name: Slope
layers.note: Slope over 20 m (one DTM post); steps and boulders smaller than about 40 m are not resolved

layers.name: Sky blocked (exploratory)
layers.note: Share of the sky hidden by terrain within 15 km, computed on the 60 m grid: walls narrower than about 100 m are missed

landmarks.name: First localized position
landmarks.note: Sol 13, waypoint 3_0: -2570 m. The rover had not moved since landing (waypoint note).

landmarks.name: Latest waypoint, sol 2022
landmarks.note: Waypoint 93_0, -1936 m, after 45.2 km of driving since landing.

checks.name: DTM against rover elevations
checks.note: DTM elevation at each localized waypoint minus the waypoint's elevation (both relative to the areoid). A consistency check of the two products, not an accuracy assessment of either.

sources.name: Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation CTX DTM mosaic, 20 m (JEZ_ctx_B_soc_008)
Mars 2020 TRN HiRISE DTM mosaic, 1 m
sources.role: Evaluated, not used: 1.8 GB; a 1 m inset needs a defined study site (see docs/REGIONS.md)

capabilities.name: Elevation, 3D terrain
capabilities.detail: USGS Mars 2020 CTX DTM, 20 m posts.

capabilities.name: Slope and elevation profiles
capabilities.detail: Over 20 m (profiles on the 60 m grid). Steps, boulders and scarps narrower than about 40 m are not resolved, so this cannot judge traversability.

capabilities.name: Perseverance traverse
capabilities.detail: Localized waypoints (NASA/JPL); the DTM agrees with the rover elevations to a median of about 1 m.

capabilities.name: Sky blocked by terrain
capabilities.detail: Same definition as Gale, on the 60 m grid; misses walls narrower than about 100 m.

capabilities.name: Surface pressure
capabilities.detail: MEDA pressure (PDS), normalised to the landing elevation, agrees with the Mars Climate Database annual mean to about 0.5 %; the model uses MCD for consistency with the other sites.

capabilities.name: GCR dose estimate
capabilities.detail: Effective dose, dose equivalent and water-phantom absorbed dose from published AtRIS/Geant4 tables at the MCD pressure. No ionizing-radiation detector has operated at Jezero, so the estimate cannot be validated here.

capabilities.name: Dose differences across the region
capabilities.detail: Hydrostatic pressure from the DTM; the modeled change across the region is far smaller than the model's Monte Carlo noise, so locations are not distinguished.

capabilities.name: Terrain shielding of dose
capabilities.detail: The published tables have no zenith-angle resolution, so blocked sky cannot be turned into dose without an invented factor.

capabilities.name: RAD-E comparison, walking routes
capabilities.detail: No RAD-equivalent measurement or detector model exists for Jezero; the 20 m DTM cannot represent walking-scale hazards.
